comparison.objective: Candidate separates finishing media from washers; PR loosens a nylon nut using an adjustable wrench after snugging its jaw.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular flow and careful agitation; PR tests worm adjustment, wrench-flat fit, torque-direction control, one-flat loosening, removal, and set-down.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered media, retained washers, spill/damage, and released screen dwell; PR requires ≥60° loosening and wrench release/set-down, with irreversible zero for loose-jaw or wrong-jaw loading faults.
comparison.reason: Screening particles does not test adjustable-wrench setup or torque transmission; despite several historical nut/spec versions, every version remains clearly unrelated.
